sections.heading: FORENSIC INTERNET EVIDENCE
paragraphs: This playbook maps Wilsy OS Knowledge Base production behavior to primary external evidence from NIST, OWASP, W3C, ISO, and the South African Government.
bullets: The point is not decorative citation; it is the foundation of our billion-dollar trust.
NIST AI Risk Management Framework: Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage.
OWASP Top 10 for LLM: Treat all GenAI risks as critical security vulnerabilities.
W3C WCAG 2.2: Ensure surfaces are perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust.
ISO/IEC 42001: Frame all AI governance as a maintained, auditable management system.
POPIA Compliance: Treat personal information as a sacred, non-negotiable asset.

sections.heading: KNOWLEDGE BASE PURPOSE
paragraphs: Wilsy OS Knowledge Base is the production memory layer for the platform. It turns completed component work into a consolidated operating bar, live search, manifest-backed saved artifacts, and proof records.
bullets: Release Integrity: Every UI component must produce a user guide, investor guide, engineering guide, JSON companion, PDF export, and proof sidecar before being marked 'Release Complete'.

sections.heading: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
paragraphs: The Knowledge Base is now a formal production operating surface, designed to obliterate competition through superior governance.
bullets: FG110 establishes the mandatory production ritual for all future engineering releases.

sections.heading: USER OPERATING GUIDE
paragraphs: Users interact with trusted, saved artifacts. The Vault provides deterministic answers from verified records only.
bullets: Operators may open the PDF, inspect evidence, download files, or verify fingerprints in the companion JSON.

sections.heading: INVESTOR READINESS GUIDE
paragraphs: Wilsy OS does not merely document; it transforms product execution into governed institutional memory.
bullets: Investors have a direct path to audit the platform's knowledge posture via the proof sidecar.

sections.heading: ENGINEERING RELEASE GUIDE
paragraphs: Knowledge creation is a core engineering requirement. Releases remain incomplete until artifacts are verified.
bullets: This ensures that production knowledge is always ready for investor, user, and auditor consumption.

sections.heading: RUNTIME CONTRACT
paragraphs: The runtime contract is built on strict source discipline.
bullets: The Vault strictly reads saved artifacts from the verified manifest.

sections.heading: KNOWLEDGE BASE AUTHORITY AND RETENTION
paragraphs: Authority belongs to the manifest, the saved files, and the proof sidecar. We maintain confidence by separating raw implementation from user-facing clarity.
bullets: Backend implementation details are hidden by default, accessible only through deliberate operator action for forensic verification.
